g.text: FLUTTER: when airflow feeds a structural vibration
A conceptual bending–torsion example — not a reconstruction of the movie scene.
1. A moving, twisting wing changes its airloads
Twist changes incidence; vertical velocity also
changes the relative airflow. Both affect lift & moment.
2. A feedback loop — not automatically unstable
The loop grows only if airflow supplies more
energy per cycle than damping removes.
3. After a small disturbance: compare the oscillation envelopes
ACTIVE SUPPRESSION: sensors → controller → fast control-surface motion
Correctly phased aerodynamic forces remove oscillation energy, like an added damper.
Illustrative curves only. Flutter is not ordinary forced resonance; no universal flutter speed is implied.
